'''Andrea Gill''' is the former president of the [[Senate (Belize)|Senate of Belize]]. She served from 2008 to 2012. Between 2008 and 2009, she served as president of the Forum of Presiding Officers of National Parliaments of Central America and the Caribbean (FOPREL).

==Biography==
Gill holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Biology.<ref name=profile>{{cite web|title=Senator Andrea Gill|url=http://www.nationalassembly.gov.bz/index.php/senate-upperhouse/76-members-of-the-senate/142-senator-andrea-gill|publisher=National Assembly of Belize|access-date=16 September 2015|location=Belmopan, Belize|date=16 October 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150916203933/http://www.nationalassembly.gov.bz/index.php/senate-upperhouse/76-members-of-the-senate/142-senator-andrea-gill|archive-date=2015-09-16|url-status=dead}}</ref> As part of a [[manatee]] research project, Gill was involved between 1997<ref name="Manatee Recovery Plan">{{cite web|last1=Auil|first1=N|title=Manatee Recovery Plan|url=http://eprints.uberibz.org/3/1/Belize_Manatee_Recovery_Plan.pdf|publisher=University of Belize Environmental Research Institute|access-date=16 September 2015|location=Belize City, Belize|date=1998|archive-date=4 July 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190704160543/http://eprints.uberibz.org/3/1/Belize_Manatee_Recovery_Plan.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref> and 2001<ref name="Free-Ranging Manatees in Belize">{{cite web|title=Biological Assessment and Handling of Captured Free-Ranging Manatees in Belize|url=https://fl.biology.usgs.gov/posters/Manatee/Manatees_in_Belize/manatees_in_belize.html|website=U.S. Geological Survey|publisher=Southeast Ecological Science Center|access-date=16 September 2015|location=Florida Integrated Science Center, Gainesville, Florida|date=3 December 2001}}</ref> in a manatee tagging project which focused on the Southern Lagoon.<ref name="Manatee Recovery Plan" /> She then became a teacher focusing on improving education systems.<ref name=FOPREL />

She served as [[List of Presidents of the Senate of Belize|President of the Senate of Belize]] from 14 March 2008<ref name=Amandala>{{cite news|last1=Ramos|first1=Adele|title=New legislature sworn in Friday, March 14|url=http://amandala.com.bz/news/new-legislature-sworn-in-friday-march-14/|access-date=16 September 2015|publisher=Amandala|date=18 March 2008|location=Belize City, Belize}}</ref> to 3 February 2012 when she was replaced by [[Marco Pech]].<ref name="Past Presidents">{{cite web|title=Past Presidents of the Senate |url=http://www.nationalassembly.gov.bz/index.php/senate-upperhouse/past-presidents-senate |publisher=National Assembly of Belize |access-date=16 September 2015 |location=Belmopan, Belize |url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150916203359/http://www.nationalassembly.gov.bz/index.php/senate-upperhouse/past-presidents-senate |archive-date=16 September 2015 }}</ref> In November 2008, she assumed the presidency of the Forum of Presiding Officers of National Parliaments of Central America and the Caribbean (FOPREL),<ref name=FOPREL>{{cite news|title=Belize Assumes Presidency of Regional Parliamentary Body|url=http://7newsbelize.com/sstory.php?nid=12747|access-date=16 September 2015|publisher=7 News Belize|date=28 November 2008|location=Belize City, Belize}}</ref> the first time Belize had participated in the regional body. On 12 June 2009, Gill was awarded the Golden Medal of Honour from the [[National Assembly (Nicaragua)|Legislative Assembly of the Republic of Nicaragua]] in recognition of her work to promote democracy and integration in the region.<ref name="Medal of Honor">{{cite news|last1=Ayuso|first1=Homero|title=Senate President receives Nicaragua medal of honor|url=http://www.reporter.bz/article/General/3558/|access-date=16 September 2015|publisher=The Reporter|date=19 June 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090625090914/http://www.reporter.bz/article/General/3558/|archive-date=25 June 2009|url-status=usurped|location=Belize City, Belize}}</ref> On 1 March 2010, Gill passed leadership of FOPREL to President of the National Assembly of Honduras, Congressman [[Juan Orlando Hernández]] Alvarado.<ref name="passing Foprel">{{cite news|title=Presidente de Asamblea de Honduras, asume titularidad del FOPREL|url=http://www.elsalvadornoticias.net/2010/03/01/presidente-de-asamblea-de-honduras-asume-titularidad-del-foprel/|access-date=16 September 2015|publisher=El Salvador Noticias|date=1 March 2010|location=San Salvador, El Salvador|language=es|archive-date=12 August 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180812063228/http://elsalvadornoticias.net/2010/03/01/presidente-de-asamblea-de-honduras-asume-titularidad-del-foprel/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
